audience: managed service providers that run their helpdesk and device management in Gorelo

useCases.title: Review the open and unassigned tickets
useCases.text: List tickets with status, priority, client and assignees. Read the status list to filter for open tickets. Open one ticket to read its comments.

useCases.title: Find the managed devices that need attention
useCases.text: List managed devices for a client and check their status. Read the hardware and the pending Windows updates of one device.

useCases.title: Check overdue invoices per client
useCases.text: List invoices with status, totals and client. Open one invoice to read its line items. Read the contracts to compare the billing lines.

useCases.title: Open a ticket for a client problem
useCases.text: Create a service ticket with a status, a technician group and a type. Look up the ids first with the list tools.

useCases.title: Add a note to a ticket and log the time
useCases.text: Add a private note or a public reply to a ticket. Then log the hours that you worked on it.

useCases.title: Handle an alert
useCases.text: Read the latest alerts. Link an alert to an open ticket or dismiss it.
